theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hσ : σ'' = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') _ _ := by
    rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    refine updatedStatesComm ?_
    rw [List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength Hup), List.unzip_zip (InitStatesLength Hinit)]
    exact fun x hx hx' => absurd (UpdateStatesDefined Hup x hx) (by simp [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit x hx'])
  exact ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength Hinit) (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup) (InitStatesNodup Hinit), Hσ ▸ updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength Hup) (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))⟩
